Expectation and reality
May 2026 • Family
Passed by this place several times, as it is right by the road and bought the nice appearance 
On the last night, they decided to stop by, as the place is positioning itself as a restaurant with an appropriate price tag 
Chose shrimp, rice and beef noodles for a change (since the restaurant does marine cuisine - there weren't high expectations) 
Alas, it didn't taste good. 
Beef and noodles - a glutinous mass with bits of beef, the taste of only burnt butter is not the first freshness, which you certainly don't expect from a restaurant
Shrimp in a clare - shrimp in a shell, topped by a clare. Once you peel off the shell, the whole clare is gone, and there's one unleavened shrimp, which is the point of this dish - a mystery.
Rice and crab - unleavened, you feel the crab when the shell is crunching on your teeth, there is not much taste 
Only peanuts were completely eaten, which is served as a compliment
